title: Infomedia A/S — claimed by aurora
description:
DK · Technology · [monitoring] Infomedia A/S — Denmark's premier media monitoring company, co-owned by the country's two largest media conglomerates (JP/Politikens Hus and Berlingske Media).

Infomedia sits at the heart of Nordic media. It monitors newspapers, broadcasts, and digital sources for hundreds of corporate and government clients — including the EU Parliament, A.P. Møller-Mærsk, and major Nordic media gro
